members.airbug: Suite::formatter or formatter attribute, registered separately from Measurement

differences: Measurement uses mutable start/end and Result for fallible hooks; add consumes values instead of borrowing
Formatter is registered separately; text callbacks receive already scaled values and a unit
Owned formatter units and fallible conversions replace static strings and in-place slices
Custom metric observations must be finite nonnegative batch totals
Executor receives &mut self; futures may borrow local non-Send state
Profiler hooks can return errors; selected cases receive artifact directories; deadline uses wall time

bench/tests/executors.rs: 8 all-feature and 2 no-default-feature integration tests passed on macOS
bench/tests/profiling.rs: 4 all-feature integration tests passed on macOS
remaining: Full graph/report-entrypoint formatter semantics and visual inspection
All-feature gates do not establish every possible user-defined extension combination

contracts: Hooks are profiling-only, bracket measured execution and receive the same benchmark ID and artifact directory
Profile mode runs for a requested duration without normal statistical sampling
native_differences: Criterion uses one-second warmup then estimates one remaining batch. Airbug adapts batches against a wall-clock deadline; cancellation remains cooperative between batches.
Airbug fallible hooks and unwind handling attempt stop after attempted start, preserve both primary/cleanup errors, and restore the profiler for subsequent sessions.
profiler_semantic_audit.validation: All four profiling integration tests passed with --offline --locked --all-features

coverage: Tokio owned/borrowed Runtime and owned/borrowed Handle
Completion and return-value propagation through Pending/wake
Non-Send local future and output; custom executor with borrowed mutable state and borrowed return value
Smol/Tokio timers, spawned tasks and Unix I/O reactor execution
Runtime factory construction is lazy and runtime reused across samples
executor_semantic_audit.native_difference: Executor takes &mut self instead of &self; blanket implementation supports &mut E. This permits mutable state without interior mutability. Tokio current-thread Handle still requires its runtime to be driven, as documented.
executor_semantic_audit.validation: Eight all-feature executor integration tests passed on macOS. Windows-specific I/O and runtime remain under platform acceptance.

contracts: Typed intermediate and accumulated values need no Clone bound in Airbug
Fresh-input setup runs outside measurement; zero/add accumulate batch values before conversion to f64
Custom metric totals remain separate from elapsed wall time and are normalized by operation count
Sync and async measurement preserve selected input/output destruction boundaries
Conversion failures clear the sample capture and cannot reuse the previous successful value
native_differences: Hooks are fallible and start/end take mutable self; add consumes values rather than borrowing them
Formatter registration is separate from the Measurement implementation

Airbug requires finite nonnegative totals. Criterion Measurement and sampling code impose no explicit sign check. End-to-end support for signed custom measurements in Criterion has not been established; unrestricted numeric-domain equivalence is not claimed.
